draft.reply_body:
Hello,

Good to hear the generator's job is done. We're happy either to collect it from your site or have you drop it back at the Rovaniemi depot — whichever's easier, just let us know a convenient day and we'll arrange it.

Separately, I can see Marko was going to send you a breakdown of the cement mixer trailer invoice and that doesn't seem to have gone out yet — apologies for that. I've flagged it so he can get that over to you as soon as possible.

Best regards,
Haapaharju Oy Customer Service
